items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 20.11.2026 and was sent by post from a German authority. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 24.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift for this 4-day rule). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the day after deemed delivery, so counting begins 25.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12.2026 is a working day in NRW (not Sunday/holiday), so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). Recommended send-by to allow for postal transit: 18.12.2026.

warnings: This letter is a favorable decision recognising the accident as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall); it imposes no payment obligation on the recipient — the Widerspruch deadline above is only the statutory time limit to object if the decision is disputed.

The letter explicitly instructs the recipient not to submit receipts themselves ('bitte reichen Sie selbst keine Belege ein'), as doctors/physios will bill the Unfallkasse directly — no action needed there.
